Definition
[functional distance]

Source: petersen:page-0199 ↗ def:pet-ch5-distance

The functional distance is \[ d_F(p,q)=\sup \{ |f(p)-f(q)|\mid f:M\to \mathbb R,\ |\nabla f|\le 1\text{ on }M\} . \] Always $d_F\le d$, and $d_F$ also generates the manifold topology; once smooth distance functions are established the two distances agree for $p,q$ sufficiently close.
